item.title: QNX Self-Hosted Developer Desktop
item.description:
📝 This self-hosted target environment is pre-loaded with many of the ports you'll find on the QNX Open-source Dashboard. The team is really passionate about this one, and we're eagerly looking forward to your feedback. You'll find the image in your QNX installation directory, usually ~/qnx800/images by default.
🔗 Read more: https://devblog.qnx.com/qnx-self-hosted-developer-desktop-initial-release/

item.title: Publishing your work increases your luck
item.description:
📝 Publishing your work increases your luck For every snarky comment, there are 10x as many people admiring your work. The simple act of publishing your work is one of the best ways to invite a little more luck into your life. Start anywhere, start on anything, start something.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/readme/guides/publishing-your-work
